'''Wesner''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the [[Mantellian Army|Mantellian army]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
During the latter stages of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Wesner was stationed on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], where he achieved the rank of [[Private/Legends|Private]] and served as part of the [[Thirty-first Recon]] from [[Fort Garnik]]. While on Ord Mantell, he and squad-mates helped the Republic loyalists near [[Drelliad village]] hold back the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement|separatist forces]]. He told a [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|sergeant]] and [[Voidhound|smuggler]] about the separatist snipers who were hounding the path to Fort Garnik, and about the reward that Commander [[Vray (Duros)|Vray]] was offering for anyone who could stop the snipers.

==Behind the scenes==
Wesner appears in the [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', as part of the mission "Snipe Hunt" on Ord Mantell. He is voiced by [[Fred Tatasciore]].
